◈ ARC III — ENGINES. SYSTEM: "VIEWERSHIP MILESTONE. Organic unit demonstrates compounding capability. Resonance protocols unlocked." — Your gifts deepen. Used in sequence, they resonate. The village is no longer just surviving. It is becoming something.

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
